question: On which occasion should one go to the abode of Śiva?
premises: The full-moon day is named as an occasion.
The verse gives an injunction to go there.
inference: One should go to Śiva's abode on the full-moon day.
uncertainties: The particle vā suggests an alternative not fully specified here.
plain_english: O great goddess, on the full-moon day one should go to the abode of Śiva.
